content:
maria_cs: Quick thread — we need to lock down 3 enablement touchpoints for Nimbus Health so they can hit production by EOM. Thinking: 1) kickoff + config check (30m), 2) hands-on migration workshop (90m), 3) post-migration office hours (60m).

sophie_success: +1. Can we poll for times? Nimbus has folks in PST and CET, so 9am-11am PST or 4pm-7pm CET windows work best.

aj_eng: For the hands-on we'll need their staging creds and a short preflight checklist completed. I can share the checklist doc once dates are set — https://redwood.example/preflight-nimbus (internal).

maria_cs: Cool. Proposed slots (pick 2 per session):
- Kickoff: Tue 9am PST / Tue 18:00 CET OR Wed 10am PST / Wed 19:00 CET
- Workshop: Thu 9am PST (90m) OR Fri 10:30am PST (90m)
- Office hours: Mon 11am PST OR Tue 4pm PST

liam_se: Heads-up: I'm booked Thu morning for onboarding training. Can we avoid Thu workshop at 9am? I can do Fri 10:30.

sophie_success: @maria_cs I'll run the kickoff and handle invites + calendar blocks. I'll include Nimbus PM + engineering leads. :thumbsup:

aj_eng: I'll run the hands-on (live deploy + KV cache demo). Will follow up with the checklist and a small demo repo.

maria_cs: Draft agenda for workshop — feel free to edit:
```
1) 5m intro + objectives
2) 20m infra & config walkthrough
3) 40m guided migration (step-by-step)
4) 20m tuning: batching, quantization recommendations
5) 5m next steps + Qs
```

liam_se: looks good. Suggest we record the session and capture the config snippets in a shared Notion page.

onboarding-bot: Reminder set: Workshop prep doc due 48h before session (owner: aj_eng).

maria_cs: Action items:
- Sophie: send invites + confirm attendee list (today)
- Aj: post preflight checklist & demo repo (tomorrow)
- Liam: setup recording + Notion page (before workshop)
- Maria: follow up on renewal timeline and capture any risk flags during kickoff

sophie_success: Will do — I'll ping Nimbus for preferred attendee names and timezone constraints and update here.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Once Sophie confirms attendees I'll finalize the actual slot. :rocket:
